editorial_notes.recommended_hook: GOAT Papers: Chinchilla: Compute-Optimal Large Language Models Mini-Series 3/5: Chinchilla: Compute-Optimal Large Language Models: Part 3 - 70B Outperforms 280B: The Dense Model Revolution That Defied Conventional Wisdom
